## ✅ 感谢您的贡献！

感谢您向 Manim Blocks 提交贡献。在合并之前，请先签署贡献者许可协议（CLA）：

📄 [阅读 CLA](https://github.com/Kaoyusiliao/manim-blocks/blob/main/CLA.md)

**如何签署：** 在此评论中回复以下内容即可：

> I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA

---

## ✅ Thank You for Contributing!

Before we can merge your contribution, please sign our Contributor License Agreement:

📄 [Read CLA](https://github.com/Kaoyusiliao/manim-blocks/blob/main/CLA.md)

**To sign:** Reply with this comment:

> I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA
